title: PAUSE SP GOLD TOKEN
why: Two pause score rules and three newer run-over rules introduced raw colours into ui-shared and stopped check 29.33 before its menu assertions.
now: Pause score gold and run-over seat colours use root tokens; the overlay uses the existing identical scrim token. All colours stay the same and the full shared-look check runs again.

edits.replacement:
--r-common:#9da3a8; --r-uncommon:#5fbf6a; --r-rare:#3f9de9; --r-elite:#a866e0; --r-gold:#ffc72e;
    --score-gold:#ffc04a; --seat-one:#ffb454; --seat-two:#53d9e8; /* v28.xx (cw-cx-pausesp-gold): preserve the pause sp and run-over seat colours as root tokens. */

edits.anchor: #root #pausebox #pausesp .psph b{ font:700 var(--fs-title)/1 var(--f-cond); color:#ffc04a; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; }
edits.replacement: #root #pausebox #pausesp .psph b{ font:700 var(--fs-title)/1 var(--f-cond); color:var(--score-gold); font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; }
